description: Raw run outputs for T395 (one implementation per property): the four seeded-defect controls, the three wired differentials, and the full-suite baseline comparison. All runs under tools/runner (RSS guard 4 GB, docs/infra/runner.md), repo root, -O ReleaseFast (runner default), 2026-08-06. Commands are stated with the numbers.

runs.label: I5 Defect-A control (passes==2 placement successors)
runs.output:
[I5 Defect-A control] differential FIRES on seeded passes==2 successors (general E=7364 vs specific E=5510)
[I5 Defect-A control] GREEN: fixed path agrees on every countable

[I5 Defect-B control] GREEN: fixed path agrees on every countable

runs.label: full suite after T395 changes
runs.output: exit 1 — same failure classes as the T391 baseline: test binaries whose tests all pass but that exit non-zero under the Zig 0.16 --listen=- runner quirk ('internal test runner failure: EndOfStream'; bellman/closure/oracle_v2_accept/battery steps, identical to T391's note), plus the 4 documented qa023_brute_2x2 budget-crash ABRTs.
